questions.question: Which part of the Company Enricher is the core domain?
options: The rules for when a suggestion needs review
questions.explanation: The review rules encode the business's own judgement. The others are generic and could come from libraries.

questions.question: Why does the core declare WebsiteSource instead of importing HttpWebsiteSource?
options: To make the core's dependencies point inwards, so adapters can change freely
Because HTTP is not allowed in Python
questions.explanation: The core states what it needs; any adapter can provide it. The core never changes when an adapter does.

questions.question: What does test_layers.py protect?
options: The rule that the core never imports adapters
questions.explanation: It turns the folder convention into a check that fails on every run if broken.
